description: Free, even after payment expiry; submits no payment. Pending: poll after retry_after_seconds (not a deadline). Ready: use fulfillment; orders need completion. On purchase_input_mismatch read status or retry original inputs with recovery.original_door and recovery.original_path. Keep status_token private; do not pay again.

purchase_id.description: The recovery.purchase_id from your purchase response.

status_token.description: The private recovery.status_token from the purchase response.

name: check_purchase

delivery_state.description: Whether the good is delivered, a human order exists, or delivery is not yet established.

recovery_state.description: Recovery readiness, separate from payment and human-work completion.

retry_after_seconds.description: Suggested delay before another free status read while recovery is pending; not a delivery deadline. Null when no recovery poll is advised.

settlement_attempted.description: This status read never submits payment.

security.the_rest: What this store never does, the standards it holds itself to, and where to report a vulnerability or a correction: https://scvd.store/mcp.md#what-every-tool-here-promises. Reporting directly: https://scvd.store/.well-known/security.txt, https://scvd.store/corrections.
security.what_it_stores_about_you: Calls contribute to rate limits and traffic counts. No caller account or cookie; private status reads require the purchase handle.
security.what_this_does_in_your_name: Nothing, outside this store. It reads our own signed records at the counter, so the answer is as fresh as our last round and no fresher, and it says exactly when that was. This store never asks for a credential, private key, or wallet secret. Payment uses buyer-signed x402 authorizations.

summary: Read a retained purchase's payment status and original terms using its private recovery handle. Free; submits no payment.
title: Check purchase status
